signals: MACD histogram turned up off a trough (pre-cross)

ladder.label: NEARING A LOW
ladder.why: Day 53 of a typical 36-42-day cycle — inside the window where lows usually form, and short-term momentum is washed out. No confirmed turn yet. Last cycle was left-translated (topped early) — a bearish structural tell.
ladder.next: Wait for the turn: a move above the low candle's high, then a close back above the 10-day average.
ladder.regime_why: weekly momentum positive; but rolling toward a weekly cross-down; 3-day crossed down; last cycle left-translated (topped early)
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: BEARISH — weekly momentum positive; but rolling toward a weekly cross-down; 3-day crossed down; last cycle left-translated (topped early) (investor cycle week 11 · daily cycle day 53).
ladder.summary_line: Short-term (daily): nearing a low. Bigger picture (counter-trend): bearish.
points: Bigger picture is bearish (counter-trend for a daily long)
Swing low printed (buyers rejected the low)
Prior cycle topped early (a tiring-trend hint)

entry.text: A cycle low is due in roughly ~0–2 trading days — watch for the turn, don't front-run it.
entry.text_zh: 周期低点预计在约 ~0–2 个交易日内出现——等待转向，切勿抢跑。

cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 53 of a typical 36–42 trading days
cycle_plain.daily_phase: overdue — past the typical window, so a low could form any day

cycle_plain.daily_phase_zh: 逾期——已超过典型窗口，低点随时可能形成
cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 11 of a typical 16–26 weeks
cycle_plain.weekly_phase: mid — the bigger up-leg is maturing

cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 中期——更大的上行段正在成熟
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its FIRST half ('left-translated') — weak cycles top early, so this hints the bigger trend is tiring.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在前半段见顶（“左移”）——弱周期见顶偏早，这暗示更大的趋势正在走弱。

ladder.early_note: ⚡ Early reversal building (heads-up): MACD histogram turned up off a trough (pre-cross). These anticipate a low BEFORE full confirmation — earlier entry, but a higher false-alarm rate, so treat as a heads-up to watch closely, not a trigger yet.
ladder.why_zh: 典型 36-42 天周期的第 53 天——处于低点通常形成的窗口内，且短期动量已被洗净。尚无确认的转向。 上一周期为左移结构（见顶偏早）——属于看空的结构性信号。
ladder.next_zh: 等待转向：先上破低点 K 线的高点，再收盘重新站上 10 日均线。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：看空 — weekly momentum positive; but rolling toward a weekly cross-down; 3-day crossed down; last cycle left-translated (topped early)（投资者周期第 11 周 · 日线周期第 53 天）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：接近低点。大局（逆势）：看空。
